questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: जोडा मिलाउँदा कुन विकल्प सही छ?
options: Caspian Sea — संसारको सबैभन्दा ठूलो बन्द जलाशय/तालको रूपमा परिचित
Lake Baikal — अफ्रिकाको सबैभन्दा ठूलो ताल
questions.explanation: Caspian Sea नाम भए पनि भौगोलिक रूपमा ठूलो बन्द जलाशय हो र विश्वकै सबैभन्दा ठूलो lake का रूपमा पनि वर्णन गरिन्छ।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: जोडा मिलाउँदा कुन विकल्प सही छ?
options: हिमाल — उच्च उचाइ र हिमाली भू-दृश्यसँग सम्बन्धित क्षेत्र
questions.explanation: नेपालको हिमाली क्षेत्र उच्च उचाइ, हिमाच्छादित पर्वत र विशिष्ट हिमाली भू-दृश्यसँग सम्बन्धित छ।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: पाम्पास घाँसे मैदान कुन क्षेत्रमा प्रसिद्ध छ?
questions.explanation: पाम्पास दक्षिण अमेरिकाको दक्षिणपूर्वी भाग, विशेषतः अर्जेन्टिनासँग सम्बन्धित उर्वर घाँसे मैदान हो।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: A — अर्जेन्टिना र आसपासको दक्षिण अमेरिका।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: तलका मध्ये कुन भनाइ गलत छ?
options: Convergent boundary मा प्लेटहरू एकअर्कातर्फ सर्छन्
Divergent boundary मा प्लेटहरू अलग हुन सक्छन्
सबै भूकम्प केवल divergent boundary मै हुन्छन्
Transform boundary मा प्लेटहरू एकअर्काको समानान्तर दिशामा सर्न सक्छन्
questions.explanation: भूकम्प विभिन्न प्रकारका प्लेट सीमामा हुन सक्छन्; त्यसैले सबै भूकम्प divergent boundary मै हुन्छन् भन्ने भनाइ गलत हो।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: D — सबै भूकम्प केवल divergent boundary मै हुन्छन्।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: तलका मध्ये कुन कथन सही छ?
options: भौगोलिक chokepoint को व्यापारसँग कुनै सम्बन्ध हुँदैन
समुद्री मार्गको अवस्थिति राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षासँग कहिल्यै जोडिँदैन
जलडमरूमध्य र नहरको नियन्त्रणले समुद्री व्यापारिक मार्गमा रणनीतिक महत्व दिन सक्छ
questions.explanation: महत्वपूर्ण जलडमरूमध्य, नहर र समुद्री मार्ग विश्व व्यापार तथा रणनीतिक सुरक्षाका दृष्टिले महत्वपूर्ण हुन सक्छन्।

questions.explanation: चुनढुंगा पानीमा घुलनशील भएकाले कार्स्ट स्थलरूप, गुफा र भूमिगत जल प्रणाली निर्माणमा महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन्छ।

questions.question: All effective projects have measurable objectives. Some government projects are effective. No project with unclear objectives is measurable. Which conclusion must be true?
options: No government project has unclear objectives
Some government projects have measurable objectives
questions.solution: The effective government projects have measurable objectives by the first statement.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: An institution requires applicants to submit documents through a single verified portal rather than by email. Conclusions: I. The institution seeks a more controlled submission process. II. Email can never be secure.
questions.solution: A verified portal indicates a controlled submission objective. The absolute claim about all email security is unsupported.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: What is the value of x? Statement I: x is an even integer greater than 4 and less than 8. Statement II: x is divisible by 3.
questions.solution: Statement I alone is sufficient because the only even integer strictly between 4 and 8 is 6.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: Before expanding the scholarship program nationwide, the authority should evaluate the pilot. Assumptions: I. Pilot results can provide evidence relevant to expansion. II. The pilot and nationwide program must be identical in every respect.
questions.solution: Evaluation assumes pilot evidence can inform the decision. Identical conditions everywhere are not necessary.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Six tasks A, B, C, D, E and F are scheduled in six slots. A is immediately before B. C is before D. E is after B. Which pair must occupy consecutive slots?
questions.solution: The condition explicitly makes A immediately before B.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: A survey found that employees who received regular feedback reported higher job satisfaction than those who did not. Conclusions: I. Regular feedback is the only cause of job satisfaction. II. Regular feedback is associated with higher reported satisfaction.
questions.solution: The survey establishes an association, not a sole causal explanation.

questions.question: Why should staff report problems safely?

questions.solution: “precede” means to come before; “proceed” means to continue or move forward.

questions.question: Choose the correct adjective form of “industry” in “an _____ process”.
questions.solution: “industrial” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: The decision was made ___ accordance with the law.
questions.solution: The fixed expression is in accordance with.

questions.question: She usually ___ to work by bus, but today she is walking.
questions.solution: The present simple describes a habitual action.

questions.question: In the sentence 'The extremely careful officer checked the file,' the word 'extremely' is a
questions.solution: Extremely modifies the adjective careful, so it is an adverb.

questions.question: Choose the clearest sentence.
options: The officer reviewed the file carefully that contained errors.
The officer reviewed carefully the file contained errors.
The officer the file reviewed carefully that contained errors.
The officer carefully reviewed the file that contained errors.
questions.solution: The modifier carefully is naturally placed before the verb phrase, and the relative clause clearly modifies file.

questions.question: Unless you ___ the form, your application cannot be processed.
questions.solution: Unless introduces a real condition, so present simple is used for the future meaning.

questions.question: There ___ several reasons for the delay.
questions.solution: The real subject reasons is plural, so are is required.

questions.question: The report consists ___ five sections.
questions.solution: The fixed construction is consists of.

questions.question: When I reached the office, the meeting ___.
questions.solution: The meeting started before I reached the office, so past perfect is appropriate.
